_note: Three pilot program traces carried over from the original ImpactLine (lib/impactline/programs.ts). Each joins a law to a program with two official identifiers: the law's Disaster Emergency Fund Code and the program's Assistance Listing number.

programs.name: Clean School Bus Program
programs.authority: IIJA Division G, Title XI, section 71101. EPA can award eligible local recipients directly; state redistribution is not a universal step.

guides.title: Identify the recipient and rebate or grant round
guides.description: Find the official award and dated project status. Rebate "Project Complete" means closeout submitted and can precede EPA approval. Grant exports can repeat totals across school districts.

guides.title: Review selection and payment-request requirements
guides.description: For the selected rebate round, check selection, eligible purchase orders, payment request and EPA approval.

guides.title: Verify delivery, charging and old-bus disposition
guides.description: Rebate closeout requires applicable delivery, charging and old-bus disposition evidence. Submission and approval must be recorded separately.

state_guides.title: Check California requirements and separate assistance
state_guides.description: Contextual check: CARB funding streams are separate from EPA awards. Identify applicable local permitting, utility interconnection and state rules for the actual site; this portal does not establish all local requirements.

programs.caution: A different law also funds clean heavy-duty vehicles. An award is listed here only when Treasury tagged it with the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act's own fund code.

programs.name: Bridge Formula Program
programs.authority: IIJA Division J, Title VIII, Highway Infrastructure Programs. Separate from the competitive Bridge Investment Program.

guides.title: Confirm bridge eligibility and funding source
guides.description: Program guidance: match the bridge and project identifiers to the Bridge Formula Program. A bridge project is not automatically funded by this law.

guides.title: Locate program allocations and implementation guidance
guides.description: Federal program records identify the formula program and its implementation materials; project-level expenditure remains a separate question.

state_guides.title: Find the project phase in the approved Texas STIP
state_guides.description: For applicable federally funded work, verify the project phase in the approved STIP and amendments. Programming is not construction completion.

state_guides.title: Verify federal authorization for local-government work
state_guides.description: For this local-government branch, verify Federal Project Authorization and Agreement and the State Letter of Authority before the applicable phase.

state_guides.title: Match the TxDOT project identifier
state_guides.description: Use official reported status, schedule and funding as leads. A tracker status is not an inspection certificate.

state_guides.title: Collect construction and inspection records
state_guides.description: For local-government projects, seek the executed contract, construction progress and final inspection and acceptance.

state_guides.title: Reconcile closeout, cost share and final payment
state_guides.description: For the applicable local-government project, collect completion concurrence, cost-share determination, final payment and maintenance requirements.

programs.caution: Formula highway funds reach projects through state transportation departments. A federal award record to a state is not a record of any one bridge.

programs.name: Enabling Middle Mile Broadband Infrastructure Program
programs.authority: IIJA Division F, Title IV, section 60401. This is distinct from BEAD and from separately funded state middle-mile programs.

guides.title: Identify the named award and approved network scope
guides.description: Match the project to the federal Middle Mile program and confirm the approved network scope and applicable award conditions.

guides.title: Collect financial, technical and location reports
guides.description: Program guidance describes reporting requirements. The applicable permits and physical completion records must be checked for each project.

programs.caution: State middle-mile programs funded from other sources do not appear here.
